approval_scope: Pre-measurement labels, fixed criteria and corrected corpus inclusion for bounded functional acceptance only. Not human approval, upstream protocol approval, runtime verification or generalization evidence.
digest_provenance: Parent shasum -a256 output; independent reviewer reread unchanged labels and corrected source semantics before measurement.

frozen_design.tokenizer: Maximal Unicode alphanumeric runs followed by Unicode lowercase; punctuation separates; no stemming, accent folding, model or network
frozen_design.document_inclusion: Each native entry once; complete native C/H/E/session section or file once, no repeated ID/title prefix; node title and substantive body disjoint; typed Markdown file extra documents contain only introductory prose; recipes already indexed whole are excluded from extra documents; other loaded knowledge Markdown is complete; raw src/evidence excluded
frozen_design.similarity: Weighted set Jaccard over title and substantive typed-body tokens with equal field weights; weight(t)=ln(1+(N-df(t)+0.5)/(df(t)+0.5)); empty union scores zero
frozen_design.heldout_policy: Freeze labels, criteria, tokenizer and inclusion before measurement; no tuning on heldout

limitations: Four singleton queries per split; both recall thresholds require four hits. Not population recall.
One crafted exact-replay duplicate per split; no claimed natural duplicate discovery or paraphrase robustness.
Duplicate precision covers labeled left-versus-appended-right relations only, not other emitted candidates.
Natural duplicates and further verification controls remain prerequisites for broader quality or publication claims.
Separate automated approval does not replace original label human-review metadata or upstream F1-F7 review.
measurement_status: frozen before parent verification; no measurements in review
